title: Before You Buy The RTX 5070! 3070 vs 5070 Gaming Performance
description:
In this video, I review the Nvidia RTX 5070. This specific model is the Asus TUF Gaming OC. I compare the 5070 to the 3070. The ray tracing improvements are very impressive as well. I was surprised at how smooth multi frame generation felt.  My experience has been enjoyable with the 5070 so far. This is my dedicated review of the Nvidia RTX 5070 GPU.
